evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: Search by content fingerprinting is a distinct requirement (specific technique) different from other search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery is a different actor-context/goaling mechanism than other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: Social/similarity-based discovery is distinct from other search approaches (different data source and goal).

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Searching by similarity to a given music video (including ringback tones) is a specific use case distinct from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path.
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-based discovery specifies a different source of relevance (enriched metadata) and goal than other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: Uploading tagged videos and persisting tags for processing is a distinct ingestion/processing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: Providing thumbnail sequences is a specific UI/representation requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: General 'similar items' info is distinct from other, more specific similarity stories (different scope and intent).

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: 'Perceptually similar' constrains the similarity measure (a business rule), making this a distinct requirement from generic similarity.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations derived from similar profiles is a specific recommendation source, distinct from other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: News-event-based recommendations are a different trigger/context and goal than other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Person-identification and linking to related information targets a distinct entity and outcome.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify products in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a different entity type and use case than person/brand/logo identification.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo detection targets a specific asset type distinct from other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is a distinct entity-focused requirement separate from other detection tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation (via uploaded picture) is a specific input/output mapping different from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest.
evaluations.rationale: Geographic/POI-based discovery is a unique context and interaction model not replicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a specific search modality distinct from other retrieval requirements.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Admin validation and editing of segmentation is an editorial/admin task distinct from user-facing segmentation or automated segmentation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment.
evaluations.rationale: Annotating news segments and topic extraction is a specific content-understanding requirement separate from other admin tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects.
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct operational requirement focused on asset quality.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting prior editing of audio is a specific forensic check not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter nudity content.
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering nudity is a specific moderation rule distinct from other prefiltering stories that use different cues.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information.
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset based prefiltering (technical features) is distinct from high-level metadata prefiltering and other moderation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement.
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation is a different compliance/legal requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user.
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefiltering is a distinct strategy from low-level prefiltering and other moderation stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
evaluations.rationale: Assessing picture interestingness using combined signals is a unique analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments.
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on annotations/Talk is a distinct notification/use-of-signals requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify volunteer types.
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is a unique classification task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features.
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo-specific preclassification using low-level features targets a particular dataset and method, distinct from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting 'no classifiable animals' in Snapshot Serengeti is dataset-specific and different from similar tasks in other projects.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images.
evaluations.rationale: Image-series detection for timestamp issues is a unique processing requirement tied to a specific problem.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Snapshot Serengeti is a domain-specific task distinct from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., attributes of animals) is a different target than species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct analytic requirement (numerical detection) separate from classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal.
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is dataset- and task-specific and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting 'no classifiable plankton' is the plankton-domain analogue of other 'no classifiable X' stories but dataset-specific and therefore unique.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a different measurement requirement from segmentation or species detection.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is dataset-specific and distinct from other classification tasks in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab.
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis to shorten videos is a unique processing/transformation requirement tied to a particular project.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg.
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying time) is a specific detection task distinct from motion-analysis/video reduction.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images.
evaluations.rationale: Satellite-image feature detection is a unique remote-sensing requirement different from other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience.
evaluations.rationale: Assessing classification weight based on volunteer experience is a specific scoring/business-rule requirement distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors.
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is a concrete preprocessing task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect moving and transient objects in the images.
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct detection class and use-case.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files.
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a specific processing task distinct from audio-quality assessment or other audio tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group whale calls that are similar.
evaluations.rationale: Grouping whale calls is a domain-specific clustering requirement distinct from other grouping tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file.
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a different measurement/detection goal than grouping or other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Timing decisions about interruptions are a distinct UX/engagement requirement separate from content of interruption or education tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Deciding the medium of interruption is a different business decision (medium selection) beyond just when to interrupt.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Timing education is a distinct decision type (educational prompting) different from interruption/timing or content-selection stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the medium for education is a specific requirement separate from deciding when or what education to give.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Choosing the content ('which piece') is a different decision than timing or medium and is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is a specific signal-detection requirement distinct from other Talk/comment related stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Deciding when the bot should comment is a scheduling/trigger requirement separate from other Zoonibot behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should give an explanation.
evaluations.rationale: Triggering explanatory responses is a specific bot behavior distinct from commenting or content selection.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Determining bot message content is a separate content-authoring requirement distinct from timing triggers.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group subjects by similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Generic grouping of subjects by similarity is a broad clustering task; other grouping items are dataset- or modality-specific and therefore distinct.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences.
evaluations.rationale: Recommending projects to volunteers is a distinct recommendation goal (project-level) and actor-oriented task separate from content recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them.
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique content-processing requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
